description: Land Title Settlement Department - Muwagama, Ratnapura D/S Division, Ratnapura District    - Cad. Map No. 620272
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels (including parcel numbers, block numbers, cadastral maps, and location details) in various villages. The content focuses on land ownership determinations and title settlements, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
